candidate.title: Methyl-Seq / MRE-Seq
candidate.scope: The assigned Illumina poster row titled Methyl-Seq / MRE-Seq, at explanatory schematic scope: genomic DNA with methylated sites is split into MspI and HpaII arms, digested, sequenced separately, and compared to identify protected sites. The row groups two distinct named targets, not proven aliases. The MRE-Seq association is resolved against the cited Maunakea implementation using a separately identified paper-supported pooled-library interface, while preserving the poster route. Adjacent scRRBS, BSAS, EpiRADseq and the right-side chemical structure are contextual pixels outside this extraction. No unshown complementary assay or routine execution details are added as target workflows.

states.label: Genomic DNA containing methylated sites
features: Biological target is genomic cytosine methylation; chemical substrate is genomic DNA.
The left overview uses red dots on blue DNA and a yellow highlighted region. It describes the target rather than an enrichment operation.
The detailed cartoons label C C G G and use a red mark above a C. No 5′/3′ polarity or chemical end-group legend is supplied.
